cause_classes.rotated_header_banner: rotated grid: glyph boxes of the banner 'Number of months or driving distance, whichever comes first' overlapped the header cells, so only the last interval points (144/156 months) were read and every mark became 'FIRST at 96,000 mi / 144 months' (grid(): cells cropped by overlap, points filtered by number(); now characters by centre, columns by geometry)
cause_classes.grid_subrow_engine_cell: grid row split into sub-rows by an engine cell ('TGDI' / 'EXCEPT TGDI', 'Smartstream G1.6 T-GDi', 'HEV' / 'PHEV'): the sub-row label replaced the item label and the row was dropped; now the item label is kept and the engine cell goes to applicability
cause_classes.grid_merged_cells: one mark / text cell serving several stacked item rows (Kia 2022+ grids): only one row was read; now every row of the merged cell
cause_classes.first_subsequent_clause: 'At first, inspect 40,000 miles ...' (no 'at'), 'or 120 monthsAfter that' (glued words), '10 years', 'mile' / 'mi.' were not parsed: FIRST lost, months lost or SUBSEQUENT read as EVERY (clauses())
cause_classes.list_first_after_clause: list format: '(First, X miles (Y km) or Z months after every A ...)' was taken as a mileage block header, so the bullets after it got X / Z as their block point and the FIRST / SUBSEQUENT steps came from wrong points (e.g. 37,500 mi / 6 months, 67,500 mi / 30 months)
cause_classes.list_reading_order: list format read in page-text order (left / right columns interleaved, continuation bullets after '(Continued)' lost or put under the wrong block); now read column by column, page by page, the block carried across columns and pages
cause_classes.list_own_interval: list bullet with its own interval ('(Every 7,500 miles ... or 12 months)', ': Every ...', '- Turbo GDI (...)') was given the block's months instead of the stated ones, or the engine variant was lost
cause_classes.cell_truncation: severe-table / text cell cut at its ruling ('EVERY 3,750 MILES (6,000 ', 'or 6 mo'): printed km and months lost (km converted from miles); now the cell is completed from the page text
cause_classes.engine_applicability: engine applicability now from the row's engine cell or the label ('(MPI/GDI)', '(Turbo GDI)') instead of only the table heading; same values under a narrower key (or two engines that used to collide and were withheld as a conflict)
cause_classes.job_mapping: job of the row: 'Manual transmission fluid' / 'MANUAL TRANSAXLE FLUID' is manual_transmission_fluid (shared JOBS list changed in 94e7925; 'manual transaxle' added for HMC), not transmission_fluid
cause_classes.year_runs_regrouped: same values, model-year run regrouped because a neighbouring year's item changed
cause_classes.label_verb_vs_mark: row label names an operation the mark contradicts ('Rotate Tires ...' marked I = inspect): ambiguous, not written (gap)
cause_classes.irregular_header_or_marks: printed header points or marks are not regular (e.g. 2022 Kona Electric 'Km x 1,000 ... 64 75 80'): the old builder dropped the irregular km row and converted miles; now not written (gap)
cause_classes.first_after_different_operations: 'At first, inspect at 6,000 miles ... After that, replace every 48,000 miles ...' (2022/2023 Kona N brake fluid): first and following intervals name different operations; the old builder wrote INSPECT FIRST + REPLACE SUBSEQUENT, now a gap
cause_classes.conflict_withheld: the same document now gives two different values for one item (e.g. two 'Rotate tires' rows); not written (conflict)
cause_classes.km_first_not_read: km-first text ('every 91,000 km (56,000 miles)'): not converted, as before for km-first schedules (gap)
cause_classes.newly_read: row / bullet / severe row not read before (marks found by geometry, text located in the page text)
cause_classes.inverter_coolant_job: audit round 1: a hybrid's coolant row names the circuit ('Coolant (Inverter)' / 'HEV*4', 'Inverter coolant', 'Replace inverter coolant'): job inverter_coolant, not engine_coolant (the JOBS pattern 'coolant' took every coolant row); a row naming both circuits ('Engine coolant / Inverter coolant', 'Coolant (Engine/Inverter)') states one interval for both, so it gives an engine_coolant and an inverter_coolant item
cause_classes.engine_footnote_scope: audit round 1: an engine footnote of a list page ('*6 : Engine oil (2.0 TGDI) Replace every 6,500 miles (10,000 km) or 12 months', '*3 Engine oil (1.6 TGDI/2.0 TGDI) At first, replace at 3,000 miles ...') was not read (the label 'Engine oil' named no job, '*6 :' and 'At first,' did not match); it is now that engine's item (job of the bullet that carries the mark), and the bullet with the mark ('Replace engine oil and filter *6 (Every 7,500 miles ...)') is for the other engines (engine_except); a document that prints the footnote with different values on different pages (2018 Sorento: 12 months on most pages, 6 months on pp.499/502) gives a conflict, nothing written
cause_classes.implied_thousands: header 'Miles' / 'Km' printed without 'x 1,000' (2020 Sonata Hybrid): read as thousands only when both rows agree
cause_classes.drive_scope_label: audit round 2: a drive mark printed in the row label / bullet ('Rear differential oil (AWD)', 'Transfer case oil (AWD)', 'Differential oil (rear) (AWD)', 'Transfer case oil (4WD)') was not carried into applicability, so the item applied to every drive; now applicability.drive (same values, narrower scope)
cause_classes.drive_scope_one_part: audit round 2: a row that names two parts and puts the drive mark on one of them ('Front (AWD) / rear differential oil', 'Front differential oil (AWD) / Rear differential oil') gives no single drive scope for the item; not written (gap)
